verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You bled you heart out
Now I feel love beat in my chest
How wonderful

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You gave your beauty
In exchange for my ugliness
How wonderful

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You left your perfection
and embrace our rejection, Oh God

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
How marvellous, how boundless
Is your love, is your love

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
How wonderful, sacrificial
Is your love for me

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
You put on our chains
Sent us out through the open
How wonder

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
You took our sadness
Crowned us with joy and real
How wonderful

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Yes, Jesus loves me
Yes, Jesus loves me, how wonderful

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Yes, Jesus loves me
This is love, You gave yourself
